# What does the XERJ benchmark board say?

XERJ ingests 1.72× faster than Elasticsearch 8.13.4 and its index is 1.61×
smaller on disk.

kNN search at k=10 comes in at 1.18× on the same board.

Our internal runs also showed 7.3× on filtered aggregations and a 44% drop in
p95 latency.
